id: title:benjackwhite:route workflow usage by billing category

review.posthog_relevance: Adds workflow-specific billing tracking and SMS workflow support, separating workflow billing from CDP billing.
review.reason: The change introduces workflow-specific billing usage keys and an SMS workflow handler, replacing webhook-triggered billing. This establishes a new billing path and records workflow invocations separately from CDP billing. While the implementation is substantive, the complete operational and billing context is not fully demonstrated, and the benefit is not independently verified.
review.uncertainty: The complete billing and workflow implementation context is not available; the benefit is inferred rather than demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made; score is withheld.

observations.behavior: Adds a workflow-specific billing usage key and its corresponding handler, while removing the previous webhook-triggered billing and its test assertion.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds an SMS workflow handler alongside existing email and push handlers, establishing a new billing path for workflow invocations.

observations.behavior: Replaces the removed webhook billing with workflow-specific billing, including the SMS handler and its usage key.
observations.posthog_connection: Assigns the SMS workflow handler to the workflow executor, completing the workflow billing implementation.
